about.commitmentDesc: Twiyemeje kurinda ibanga ry'amakuru, kwinjira mu buryo bwizewe, no kubaka ibikoresho bihuye n'uko ibigo bikora buri munsi.
about.label: Ibyerekeye Imboni
about.missionDesc: Koroshya ubuzima bw'ikigo duhuza buri wese ubigizemo uruhare (abanyeshuri, abarimu, ababyeyi n'abakozi b'amacumbi) ku rubuga rumwe rusobanutse kandi rwizewe.
about.quote: "Ikigo kigendera ku itumanaho. Imboni ituma iryo tumanaho risobanuka, rigera ku gihe, kandi rikagera ku bantu bakwiye, buri gihe."
about.serveDesc: Imboni yubakiwe ibigo byakira abanyeshuri bifuza gusobanuka, kugaragaza ukuri no gukora neza muri buri gikorwa cy'ikigo.
about.subtitle: Imboni yateguriwe ibigo byakira abanyeshuri, aho abanyeshuri, abarimu, ababyeyi n'abakozi baba ku kigo bose bakeneye guhora bahujwe kandi bamenyeshwa buri munsi.
about.title: Yubatswe hagendewe ku muryango w'ikigo cyawe

privacy.accessDis: Umuyobozi ushinzwe imyitwarire abona amakuru y'imyitwarire n'ay'amacumbi.
privacy.accessDos: Umuyobozi w'Amasomo acunga gahunda, amanota n'inyandiko z'amasomo.
privacy.accessNote: Aya mabwiriza ashyirwa mu bikorwa kuri seriveri, ntabwo ari uguhisha gusa ku rubuga. Ibikorwa by'ubuyobozi byihariye byandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura cyerekana uwakoze iki n'igihe.
privacy.changesBody: Iyi nyandiko niyo ihinduka mu buryo bufatika, amashuri akoresha Imboni arabimenyeshwa. Gukomeza kuyikoresha nyuma y'impinduka bisobanura kuyemera uko yavuguruwe.
privacy.childrenBody: Ibyinshi Imboni ibika bireba abana bato, kandi birimo ibyiciro byoroshye guhungabana ahantu hose: ubuzima n'amateka y'imyitwarire. Tubifata nk'imbogamizi nyayo. Aho guhitamo mu iyubakwa bihitamo hagati y'ubworoherane n'ugushyira ahagaragara inyandiko y'umunyeshuri, duhitamo icyoroshye gike.
privacy.closing: Iyi nyandiko isobanura imikorere ya tekiniki n'iy'imitunganyirize. Si inama y'ubwunganizi mu mategeko, kandi ntisimbura politiki y'ibanga ikigo cyawe gisabwa gutangariza ababyeyi.
privacy.holdsBody: Imboni ibika ibyo ikigo gikeneye kugira ngo gikore: amazina n'aho abanyeshuri, ababyeyi n'abakozi baboneka; amakuru y'amasomo arimo amanota, kwitabira n'imikoro; amakuru y'ubuzima nk'ubwoko bw'amaraso, ibibatera allergie n'indwara; amakuru y'imyitwarire n'ay'amacumbi; n'uko amafaranga y'ishuri ahagaze. Amagambo y'ibanga ntabikwa na rimwe, hakabikwa gusa ibimenyetso byayo bidasubira inyuma.
privacy.intro: Iyi paji isobanura uko Imboni ikora nk'utanga iyi porogaramu. Buri kigo gikoresha Imboni ni cyo gishinzwe amakuru y'abanyeshuri bacyo, kandi ni cyo gitangaza politiki yacyo y'ibanga ku babyeyi. Niba uri umubyeyi cyangwa umunyeshuri, saba iy'ikigo cyawe.
privacy.isolationBody: Buri kigo gihabwa ahacyo bwite muri banki y'amakuru. Ibigo bibiri ntibisangira imbonerahamwe kandi ntibitandukanywa n'akayunguruzo ko muri porogaramu kashobora kwibeshya. Ikibazo gikoreshwa n'ikigo kimwe ntigishobora kugarura imirongo y'ikindi kigo, kuko iyo mirongo itari mu mbonerahamwe gisoma.
privacy.isolationTitle: Amashuri atandukanywa ku rwego rwa banki y'amakuru
privacy.notCollectBody: Uburyo bwacu bwo gukurikirana amakosa bwashyizweho kutigera bufata amakuru bwite. Amanota, inyandiko z'ubuvuzi, iz'imyitwarire, ibirimo mu byifuzo, aderesi za imeyili n'ibimenyetso byo kwinjira ntibishyirwa muri raporo z'amakosa, bityo ntibyoherezwa hanze igihe hari ikigenda nabi. Ibi ni icyemezo cyafashwe, si uko byari bisanzwe.
privacy.notSell: Ntitugurisha amakuru bwite, kandi ntitwayakoresha mu kwamamaza cyangwa gusesengura imyirondoro.
privacy.protectBackup: Banki y'amakuru ibikwa ku bundi buryo buri joro.
privacy.protectHash: Amagambo y'ibanga abikwa mu buryo budasubira inyuma, ntashobora kugarurwa.
privacy.protectThrottle: Kwinjira byanze kenshi bigabanyirizwa umuvuduko kugira ngo hatagira ukeka ijambo ry'ibanga.
privacy.protectTls: Amakuru yose yohererezwa ari mu ibanga rya TLS.
privacy.protectTwoFactor: Kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri birahari kuri konti z'abakozi.
privacy.retentionBody: Amashuri ni yo yifatira icyemezo cy'igihe abika inyandiko, akurikije inshingano zayo mu mategeko. Imboni itanga uburyo bwo gusiba amakuru kugira ngo ikigo gishobore gukuraho amakuru bwite y'umuntu igihe atagikenewe cyangwa igihe hatanzwe icyifuzo cyemewe.
privacy.rightsBody: Ibyifuzo byo kubona, gukosora cyangwa gusiba amakuru bwite bishyikirizwa ikigo gifite izo nyandiko, kuko ari cyo kizishinzwe. Niba utazi uwo wavugana na we, cyangwa ikigo cyawe kidashobora kugufasha,
privacy.rightsBodyEnd: tuzayoborera icyifuzo cyawe aho kigomba kujya.
privacy.subtitle: Uko Imboni ifata amakuru amashuri aduha yizeye.
privacy.title: Ibanga n'irinda ry'amakuru
privacy.translationNotice: Iyi ni ubuhinduzi. Igihe habaye ukutumvikana hagati y'indimi, inyandiko y'Icyongereza ni yo ifite agaciro.

terms.accountsBody: Ikigo cyawe ni cyo gishinzwe konti zacyo: uwatumiwe, inshingano ahabwa, no gukuraho uburenganzira igihe umuntu agiye. Amakuru yo kwinjira ntagomba gusangirwa. Kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri birahari kandi turagusaba kubikoresha kuri konti z'abayobozi.
terms.availabilityBody: Tugamije ko serivisi iboneka igihe cyose ariko ntitwiyemeza ko itazigera ihagarara. Ibikorwa byo kuyisana biteganywa hanze y'amasaha y'ishuri aho bishoboka. Serivisi itangwa uko iri, nta cyemezo ko itazagira amakosa.
terms.backupsBody: Banki y'amakuru ibikwa ku bundi buryo buri joro. Ubwo bubiko ni ingamba zo kwirinda amakosa yacu, si ibisimbura imicungire y'inyandiko zawe: ubike kopi zawe z'ibyo amategeko agusaba kubika.
terms.changesBody: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza. Impinduka zifatika zimenyeshwa ibigo mbere y'igihe. Gukomeza gukoresha serivisi nyuma y'impinduka bivuze kwemera amabwiriza yavuguruwe.
terms.closing: Aya mabwiriza yanditswe mu magambo yoroshye kugira ngo yumvikane, atari ugutangaza. Ntabwo asimbura inama y'umunyamategeko, kandi agomba gusuzumwa n'umunyamategeko mbere yo kuyashingiraho mu masezerano y'ubucuruzi.
terms.dataBody: Inyandiko zose z'abanyeshuri, ababyeyi n'abakozi ikigo cyawe cyinjiza zikomeza kuba iz'ikigo. Ikigo cyawe ni cyo gishinzwe ayo makuru; twe tuyakoresha dukurikije amabwiriza yawe kugira ngo dutange serivisi. Ntitwayagurisha, kandi ntitwayakoresha mu kwamamaza. Reba
terms.endingBody: Ikigo gishobora guhagarika gukoresha Imboni igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Nugisaba mu gihe gikwiye nyuma yo kugenda, tuzaguha kopi y'amakuru y'ikigo cyawe hanyuma tuyasibe. Dushobora guhagarika cyangwa gufunga konti irenga aya mabwiriza, kandi tukavuga impamvu.
terms.lawBody: Aya masezerano agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda.
terms.liabilityBody: Mu rugero amategeko yemera, inshingano zacu zigarukira ku mafaranga yishyuwe kuri serivisi mu mezi cumi n'abiri mbere y'ikirego. Ntidushinzwe igihombo kitaziguye cyangwa gikomoka ku kindi. Nta na kimwe muri aya mabwiriza kigabanya inshingano amategeko atemera ko zagabanywa.
terms.partiesBody: Aya masezerano ari hagati ya Imboni Education n'ikigo gifungura konti. Uwiyandikisha yemeza ko afite ububasha bwo kuyagirana mu izina ry'ikigo.
terms.paymentBody: Gahunda zishyurwa zishyurwa mbere y'igihe cyumvikanyweho. Konti nitinda kwishyura, tuzabimenyesha ku rubuga mbere yo gufata ikindi cyemezo. Nitikomeza kutishyurwa igihe cy'ubuntu kirangiye, konti irahagarikwa, bivuze ko abakozi bacyashobora kwinjira bakishyura umwenda ariko ibindi byose bya sisitemu ntibiboneke. Guhagarikwa ntibisiba amakuru.
terms.plansBodyEnd: Kugera ku mubare ntarengwa bibuza kongeramo abanyeshuri cyangwa abakozi bashya; ntibisiba ikintu na kimwe kandi ntibibuza kugera ku nyandiko zisanzwe muri sisitemu. Konti z'ababyeyi ni ubuntu kandi ntizibarwa.
terms.plansBodyStart: Buri gahunda ifite umubare ntarengwa w'abanyeshuri n'abakozi, watangajwe ku
terms.subtitle: Amasezerano hagati ya Imboni n'ibigo bikoresha iyi sisitemu.
terms.summary: Incamake mu magambo yoroshye: yikoreshe mu gucunga ikigo cyawe, urinde konti zawe, wishyure gahunda uriho. Amakuru yawe akomeza kuba ayawe, urashobora kuyijyana, kandi ntitwayagurisha.
terms.title: Amabwiriza y'imikoreshereze
terms.useMalware: gushyiramo porogaramu mbi, cyangwa ibintu udafitiye uburenganzira;
terms.useProbe: kugerageza kugera ku makuru y'ikindi kigo, cyangwa gusuzuma no kugerageza umutekano wa sisitemu utabifitiye uruhushya rwanditse;
terms.useResell: kongera kugurisha cyangwa gutanga uburenganzira ku bandi nta masezerano.
terms.useUnlawful: gukoresha serivisi mu bikorwa binyuranyije n'amategeko, cyangwa mu guhutaza no guhungabanya undi;
